name: Urban Legend
body:
Urban legends build reputations in the shadows, a story to most, often striking fear or unease in those that cross their path.

Class Features
Dual Identity (Ex)

This ability functions similarly to the vigilante ability of the same name though the circumstances and existence of the identities creates the following differences. The urban legend has two identities, one as themselves and one as some secretive person or thing talked about in hushed tones and late at night, hereby referred to as their legendary identity. In essence the urban legend is both an adventurer and the antagonist in a cautionary tale or horror story.

When in the guise of their legendary identity the urban legend gains a bonus on Intimidation checks equal to 1/2 their class level. Unlike a vigilante, an urban legend and their legendary identity can be of more varied alignments as long as the two identities are not diametrically opposed. For example, a Lawful Good urban legend could maintain a Lawful Evil or Neutral Evil legendary identity but not a Chaotic Evil One. As with a vigilante, any attempts to scry or otherwise locate the urban legend work only if the urban legend is currently in the identity the creature is attempting to locate (or if the creature knows that the two identities are the same individual). Otherwise, the spell or effect has no effect, revealing nothing but darkness, as if the target were invalid or did not exist.

This ability replaces the get the job done at 1st level.

Like A Whisper (Ex)

At 1st level, an urban legend is already adept at remaining unseen, adding 1/2 their class level to all Stealth checks and on Acrobatics checks in urban environments. This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 2nd level.

Vigilante Talents (Ex)

At 4th level the urban legend can choose vigilante talents in place of slayer talents as long as they meet the prerequisites. When gaining this feature, the urban legend chooses whether they gain access to avenger or stalker talents and once this choice is made it cannot be changed. This ability alters slayer talents.

Uncanny Resilience (Ex)

At 8th level, when in their legendary identity the urban legend is treated as having the Diehard feat and does not die until their negative hit point total is equal to twice their constitution score. This ability replaces the slayer talent gained at 8th level.
